name: Roadcall GHL Plan Snapshot Blueprints
notes: These are programmatic blueprint definitions for the full Business OS plans that use GHL SaaS Mode.

Official GHL agency snapshots are normally saved from a configured source sub-account. Use the builder to generate or apply supported location assets, then save the configured source location as a GHL Snapshot in the agency UI.
Roadcall remains the source of truth for dispatch, mechanic matching, billing, service status, and fleet data. GHL handles CRM, follow-up, reminders, summaries, and sales/onboarding automation.

plans.target: Mechanic shops and roadside providers that need website, AI telephone, widget, CRM, pipelines, workflows, calendars, and reputation management.

workflows.name: Roadcall Standard - New Lead Speed to Lead
actions: Create or update contact with roadcall and roadcall:plan-standard tags.
Create an opportunity in Roadcall Revenue Pipeline - Standard at New Lead.
Send immediate intro SMS and email with demo CTA.
Create a sales task if no demo is booked after 15 minutes.
Stop when demo_booked, checkout_completed, or subscription_started arrives.

workflows.name: Roadcall Standard - Missed Call Recovery
actions: Add roadcall:missed-call and roadcall:ai-receptionist tags.
Create recovery opportunity at Missed Call.
Send short recovery SMS with opt-out language.
Create urgent task due in 5 minutes.
Move to Recovered only after human or Roadcall confirmation.

emailTemplates.name: Roadcall Standard - Intro
emailTemplates.subject: Your Roadcall Standard setup
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Thanks for checking out Roadcall Standard. This plan gives your shop website, AI telephone, widget, CRM, pipelines, workflows, calendars, and reputation management.

Book your setup call here: {{calendar.link}}

- Roadcall

emailTemplates.name: Roadcall Standard - Missed Call Recovery
emailTemplates.subject: We saw a missed call
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Roadcall detected a missed call and queued a recovery follow-up. Summary:
{{custom_values.roadcall_ai_call_summary}}

- Roadcall

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Standard - New Lead SMS
smsTemplates.body: Thanks for checking out Roadcall Standard. Want the Roadcall AI Business OS for website, phones, CRM, workflows, calendar, and reputation? Book here: {{calendar.link}} Reply STOP to opt out.

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Standard - Missed Call SMS
smsTemplates.body: Roadcall saw a missed call. Want help recovering it? Reply YES or call back. Reply STOP to opt out.

aiReceptionist.purpose: Answer calls, qualify leads, summarize conversations, collect callback details, and route urgent roadside calls to Roadcall intake or a human.
guardrails: Do not quote final repair costs.
Do not collect full card details.

plans.target: Operators that need everything in Standard plus mobile app and customer portal access.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Demo Booked Confirmation
actions: Move opportunity to Demo Booked.
Send email and SMS confirmation.
Send 24-hour and 1-hour reminders.
Create follow-up task after demo if subscription_started is missing.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Customer Onboarding
actions: Move opportunity to Customer Active.
Create onboarding opportunity.
Send kickoff and setup checklist messages.
Create internal onboarding task.
Escalate incomplete setup after 3 days.

workflows.name: Roadcall Professional - Review Request
actions: Wait 2 hours after completed job.
Send review SMS and email when consent exists.
Send one reminder after 2 days if no review is recorded.

emailTemplates.name: Roadcall Professional - Onboarding Kickoff
emailTemplates.subject: Your Roadcall Professional onboarding
emailTemplates.body:
Hi {{contact.first_name}},

Welcome to Roadcall Professional. Next we will configure your Standard assets plus mobile app and customer portal access.

- Roadcall

emailTemplates.name: Roadcall Professional - Review Request
emailTemplates.subject: How did Roadcall do?

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Professional - Demo Reminder
smsTemplates.body: Roadcall demo reminder: {{appointment.start_time}}. Need to reschedule? {{appointment.reschedule_link}} Reply STOP to opt out.

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Professional - Review SMS
smsTemplates.body: Thanks for using Roadcall. If we helped, please leave a quick review: {{custom_values.roadcall_review_link}} Reply STOP to opt out.

plans.target: Growth teams ready for everything in Professional plus social media marketing.

workflows.name: Roadcall Advanced - Social Lead Nurture
actions: Create or update contact with advanced plan tags.
Create an opportunity in Roadcall Marketing Pipeline - Advanced.
Send social marketing follow-up when consent exists.
Create a campaign review task for the growth owner.

workflows.name: Roadcall Advanced - Campaign Review
actions: Move marketing opportunity to Optimization.
Create review task for social, funnel, and email performance.
Send owner summary email with next-step CTA.

workflows.name: Roadcall Advanced - Social Campaign Task
actions: Add social media marketing tag.
Create asset collection task.
Send checklist email for offers, service photos, and target area details.

emailTemplates.name: Roadcall Advanced - Campaign Milestone
emailTemplates.subject: Your Roadcall Advanced campaign update

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Advanced - Social Follow-up
smsTemplates.body: Roadcall Advanced follow-up: your social marketing step is ready for review. Reply STOP to opt out.

smsTemplates.name: Roadcall Advanced - Campaign Reminder
smsTemplates.body: Roadcall Advanced reminder: review your latest campaign task in GHL. Reply STOP to opt out.
